items.title: IQV Q3 deep dive: AI adoption and clinical momentum drive growth, guidance raised
items.summary: Clinical research company IQVIA (NYSE: IQV) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 8% year on year to $4.43 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $17.43 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.34 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.summary: IQVIA Holdings slipped about 0.8% in the first trading session after its Q3 2026 release, a muted move for a stock that has quietly added roughly 9.7% over the past three months. The reaction looks modest next to what the company just put on the tape. Revenue reached about US$4.4b for the quarter, and adjusted earnings per share landed well above the basic US$2.13 figure, as management leaned on the contract research engine and data assets that drive this healthcare services platform.
